Wave29 child world-evaluation-boundaries: tests03's normalized phrasing relation must preserve above/below distinction while identifying agent renamings; load_txt reset is literal '1', not numeric equivalence. StepGame score ties map to left, so replacing missing model weights with abstention changes graph answers. bAbI relation adjacency uses subtraction, unlike StepGame's directly signed reciprocal graph; an adapter that copies edge orientation would invert displacement. Command parser errors happen before apply in fixtures; bAbI read increments t before parser failure and is not transactional. CLI configuration checks cannot establish legacy school failure/publication semantics.

Wave30 child neural-parser-paths: data::batch roles index (k*T+d)*T+p; Net attention uses B,H,T,dh and masks head/key columns. lib transposes arcs dependent-major into Eisner head-major and maps local decoded h to flattened k*T+h for Net::rels. An adapter using raw h for k>0 gathers another sentence's encoder state. Vocs labels require same ordering as model output dimensions; load files independently and missing weights are not consistency proof. CLI score zips and can hide length mismatches, so output-length invariants must be checked before claiming dataset coverage. Existing world GPU caller uses parse_forms; tokenization remains caller-owned. Tests are sibling observers, not runtime production stages.
